assertion: Emphasis marks are centered on typographic units, skip spaces and punctuation, honor custom glyphs, colors and horizontal/vertical placement.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers plus native and difference images. Firefox marks each character in the ffi ligature, matching CSS typographic units; Chrome marks the ligature once. Native uses synthesized shapes permitted by CSS, so circle/triangle sizes differ from Firefox. Custom ruby mark placement and glyph-edge rasterization also differ; WebKit additionally changes the text baseline. Independent numerical tests check mark count, centers, skipped punctuation, vertical side, interline spacing and truncation. Native/Firefox difference: 8612 pixels, maximum 235.
